questions.questionText: A football is kicked so that it moves vertically upwards through the air. What is the variation in the air resistance and the resultant force acting on the ball as it moves vertically upwards? air resistance resultant force
Which statement is not correct?

options.A: Acceleration can be determined from the gradient of a velocity–time graph.
options.B: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
options.C: Displacement can be determined from the area under a velocity–time graph.
options.D: Velocity is the rate of change of distance.

questions.questionText: A guitar string is plucked. Which statement describes the resulting waves?
